narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On October 29, 2024, at approximately 0820 hours, ICE Officer [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] interviewed the subject at the Ingham County Jail in Mason, Michigan, following his arrest for driving without a license. The subject stated that he is a citizen of Mexico.
IMMIGRATION HISTORY:
Biometric record checks for the subject show that an immigration judge in Houston ordered him removed on 02/09/2016 and that he was removed on foot through the Laredo, Texas, port of entry on 04/02/2016.
The subject also stated that in 2019 he went back to Mexico on his own to visit his mother and returned a month later by crossing the river near Piedras Negras.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
An immigration detainer was lodged with the Ingham County Jail.
